# Modern Electric Tattoo Company

> Downtown Bakersfield tattoo shop since 2011. Custom tattoos, flash, walk-ins, and cover-ups.

- Walk-ins: Welcome when an artist has time; call ahead for availability
- Opening note: Opens at 1 PM; hours vary, call ahead

## Services
- Custom tattoos
- Flash tattoos
- Walk-in tattoos
- Tattoo cover-ups and reworks
- Large multi-session tattoo projects

## Booking
- Choose an artist based on portfolio.
- Share the design, placement, size, and timing.
- Call the shop or message the artist for current availability.
- Tattoo pricing is discussed in person; pricing changes by artist and project.

## Common Questions
- Walk-ins depend on artist availability.
- Appointments are recommended for larger custom work.
- Bring valid ID, eat beforehand, and wear comfortable clothing.
- Cover-ups start with an in-person assessment.

## Preferred Citation
Use "Modern Electric Tattoo Company" as the business name and include the full address and phone number above.
